messages:
olivia: Heads-up — after the 03:00 runtime rollout to v3.2.0 we saw a small but consistent latency bump for quant models and a tiny error-rate increase (~0.7%). Deploybot auto-pinned a subset; want to decide pinback vs rollback-plan now.

deploybot: auto-action: pinned runtime v3.2.0 -> affected models: quant-v4b, llama3q. reason: inferred kernel mismatch. command: `deploybot pin --runtime 3.2.0 --models quant-*` 

raj: Can we do a scoped pinback to the quant model group (pin to 3.1.9) instead of a full rollback? That avoids churn for non-quant workloads.

mike: I like scoped pinback. Plan: pinback -> graceful drain -> route-critical traffic to legacy pool -> patch SDK shim -> rollforward. Need exact runbook steps and criteria.

sarah: What are our emergency criteria? latency/SLO or support volume?

olivia: Proposed criteria: (1) p95 latency for quant models +50ms sustained over 15m OR (2) error rate >0.5% sustained over 10m OR (3) >5 customer incidents referencing observable failures in 30m. Any one triggers pinback.

eva: Draft runbook (paste):
1) Scoped pinback: `deploybot pin --runtime 3.1.9 --models "quant-*" --reason "latency regression post 3.2.0 rollout"`
2) Start rolling drains on nodes that host v3.2.0 for quant models: `infractl drain --pool runtime-3-2 --selector quant`
3) Update routing: `deploybot route set --model quant-v4b --pool legacy-3 --weight 100` (fallback)
4) Monitor key metrics for 20m (p50/p95 latency, token error rate, request success %)
5) If metrics recover -> begin SDK shim release 1.4.7 rollout and schedule rollforward test on canary fleet
6) If metrics do not recover -> escalate to infra-leads and consider full rollback of runtime across all pools

mike: Example commands for emergency pinback: 
````
deploybot pin --runtime 3.1.9 --models "quant-*" --tx "pinback-3048001234"
deploybot route set --model quant-v4b --pool legacy-3 --weight 100
infractl drain --pool runtime-3-2 --selector quant --grace 300
````

raj: SDK compatibility note — the SDK 1.4.6 has a missing fallback for kv-cache layout; shim 1.4.7 includes the fallback. QA on shim branch is green (small sanity run). Need to gate rollforward on shim rollout.

oncall-bot: ALERT: quant-v4b p95 latency spike at 3048001158 — +62ms vs baseline. link: https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/3048001158

sarah: tagging support & oncall — I'll keep watch and triage incoming tickets. If we pin, please add a short release note for customers and a postmortem stub.

olivia: I'm going to execute the scoped pinback now. I'll post the exact commands / PR: infra/runtime-pinback-3048001234 and update the release notes: "Runtime pinback for quant group after post-deploy regression; scoped to quant models; working on SDK shim rollout." :spiral_note_pad:

eva: I'll start the shim rollout pipeline as soon as pinback shows green for 10m. QA to follow.

mike: After shim 1.4.7 is live and canary passes, we do controlled rollforward: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with perf guardrails.

olivia: Final: executing now, will report back with timestamps. If anything changes escalate to infra-oncall. :white_check_mark:
